rule: The engine must extend an incomplete user ordering to a total order, but RFC v0 does not state the direction of the implicit stable-id key.

datasets.description: Tickets tied on the user sort key.

assertions: Whatever stable-id direction the RFC eventually selects must be applied identically by every adapter and included in the plan identity.
expected.gap: RFC §5 requires a stable-id final tie-break but does not define whether an implicit final key is ascending, descending, or inherited from the preceding key.
